dim_afe.description: Authorization for Expenditure. Each row is one AFE.

columns.number: Business-facing AFE identifier. use this for filtering by AFE number
columns.combined_budget_total: Original budget + all approved supplements — always use this for 'total budget' questions
columns.status: Open, Closed, Completed, Rejected or Draft — filter by status when user asks for open or active AFEs
columns.completion_date: Actual completion date — use when user asks when the AFE was completed
columns.planned_completion_date: Forecasted completion date — use when user asks when the AFE is due or expected to complete
columns.closed_date: Date the AFE was administratively closed — separate from completion_date
